verdict.rationale: Cal.com's v2 REST API docs include endpoints to create and configure event types (durations, booking fields, round-robin config). Availability is covered by schedules that event types can be pointed to, and by slot queries. Bookings can be created (regular, recurring, instant) and rescheduled, with API-key/OAuth auth, rate limits, and managed users for embedding scheduling in your own product. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the API in production use, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe found none at standard paths).
